title_zh: 成都大熊猫基地:竹林里的笨拙身影
title_en: Beautiful Places in China (15/20): Chengdu's Panda Base, Clumsy Figures in the Bamboo
note_en: 宁可…也不… expresses a preference by naming what someone chooses and what they refuse: 熊猫宁可坐着一直吃竹子，也不愿意多运动 "a panda would rather sit and munch bamboo nonstop than get more exercise." Unlike English "would rather... than...," the Chinese has a full second clause with its own verb (不愿意多运动), and 也 links the two halves; Xiao Zhou uses the same pattern at the end: 宁可多坐一会儿看熊猫，也不想急着赶去下一个地方.
